items.title: Caterpillar (CAT) Falls After Steady Guidance As Fair Value Debate Grows
items.summary: Caterpillar (CAT) just delivered third quarter 2026 results with revenue of US$20.7b and net income of US$3.3b, along with a record backlog and confirmed mid to high teens full year sales guidance. Caterpillar shares have swung sharply around the earnings release, with the 1-month share price return down 31.36% and the 3-month share price return down 33.67% as investors reacted to steady 2026 guidance, ETF selling, and a broader pullback in AI related industrial plays.
